mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id accountId, a.email_vault_token emailVaultToken FROM t_access_tenant t JOIN t_tenant_member m ON m.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND m.status='ACTIVE' JOIN t_user_account a ON a.account_id=m.account_id AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND a.email_vault_token IS NOT NULL AND a.email_verified_time IS NOT NULL WHERE t.tenant_type=#{tenantType} AND t.owner_ref_id=#{ownerRefId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_tenant_member_role g JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=g.tenant_id JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.role_id JOIN t_permission p ON p.permission_id=rp.permission_id WHERE g.tenant_member_id=m.member_id AND g.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.role_scope_key=CAST(g.tenant_id AS CHAR) AND g.effective_from <= #{now} AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to > #{now}) AND r.tenant_scope='TENANT' AND r.scope_key=g.role_scope_key AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND rp.status='ACTIVE' AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.permission_code=#{permissionCode}) ORDER BY a.account_id LIMIT #{limit}
